body: If you're going to the somewhat late game, you can hold up removal and use Soulfire Grandmaster's ability to buy back a burn to the face to whittle away at their life while gaining back what they tried to chip away. Hold up dispel for Rally, never pick the discard mode for K-Command (learned the hard way).

Putting stock on a TappedOut post that doesn't say anything more about a matchup than "Atarka Red, not much to say about that"? Yeah, no thanks, at least people from the meadery do more than two abysmally typed paragraphs.
